rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
depicted_variant: Manifestasi Squonk yang terpojok: kulit longgar berkutil/tahi lalat runtuh menjadi air mata sebelum seluruh tubuh hilang.

visual_requirements.description: Kulit kebesaran penuh kutil dan tahi lalat, mata terus menangis; tubuh sedang larut sehingga bentuk lengkap tidak ditetapkan.
Kulit dan bagian bawah sosok larut menjadi air mata jernih, mengalir deras di lantai hutan.

aura: Kesan menggetarkan berasal dari makhluk yang secara fisik larut menjadi air mata c05, tetap sedih/terpojok bukan jahat.
artistic_choices: Wujud lengkap tidak didokumentasi, maka memilih manifestasi aktif c05: close-up kulit/mata dan tubuh larut; tidak menciptakan jumlah kaki, telinga, snout, tanduk atau struktur spesies.
Warna kulit, framing sangat dekat dan cahaya bulan editorial. Tidak memperbesar ukuran menjadi raksasa dan tidak membuat makhluk baik hati menjadi predator.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Squonk at the terrifyingly wondrous instant it dissolves into its own tears when cornered, a sorrowful harmless forest creature, NOT an evil predator.
ANATOMY: the visible subject is a hunched living mass of grossly ill-fitting loose skin covered in irregular warts and dark moles, with two sorrowful wet eyes emerging amid heavy sagging folds; no identifiable ordinary animal species. The whole lower form is actively becoming water so no complete limb plan is asserted [squonk-c04, squonk-c05]. No snout, horns, ears or claws.
MOMENT: RECOILING toward the close viewer as its loose folded skin collapses downward into clear tears, eyes wide with frightened sorrow, huge creases pulling and stretching as the body loses cohesion.
POWER: transparent tears stream from both eyes and the lower skin folds physically dissolve into a rushing clear flood over the forest floor, droplet sheets and ripples replacing the bottom of its body, a documented escape rather than violence [squonk-c05]. Upper face and warty skin remain absolutely clear and dominant, not just a puddle.
SCALE & CAMERA: extremely close low view, the eyes, sagging warty skin and active dissolution fill almost all the square, normal tree roots beside it indicate no giant scale.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one narrow moonbeam reflects off the tear flood, deep walnut shadows and antique silver wet highlights.
SURFACE: heavy damp gray-brown folds with large warts and small moles, clear translucent water, wet forest roots.
SETTING: dark hemlock forest floor in northern Pennsylvania [squonk-c01].
MOOD: awe-inspiring impossible transformation, intense and unsettling yet compassionate, never cute, decorative, comic or calmly posed.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no hunters or other figures; no skin wounds, gore or nudity; no invented horns, teeth, snout, extra eyes or limbs; no text, logo, border, frame or watermark; no borrowed design; no glow aura, neon outlines, colored magic or energy ribbons.
